basic_info.description: This unique 1-bedroom, 1-bath home feels like a private retreat located in an intimate  building on a picturesque, tree-lined and quiet  block. Upon entering the apartment, you are greeted with beautiful natural light into the living room, high ceilings, and original charm. Completely renovated bath and kitchen with all new appliances. Living room  and additional breakfast room faces the open green yard with gentle step down to an urban oasis.  1 car garage included.Low HOA at $335 monthly.
